framework: National Curriculum of Pakistan 2026 (Commerce Group, Grades 11-12)
subject: Quantitative Reasoning

source.publisher: National Curriculum Council, Ministry of Federal Education and Professional Training
source.licence: Government publication; structure + our own wording only

units.title: Domain A: Number Systems and Algebraic Expressions

outcomes.text: List and classify natural, whole, integer, rational and irrational numbers.
Explain the rules of indices and surds used in business sums.
Explain like terms, coefficients and exponents in algebraic expressions.
Add, subtract and multiply algebraic expressions.
Factorise by common factor, difference of squares and quadratic trinomials.
Simplify algebraic fractions using factorised forms.

units.title: Domain B: Commercial Arithmetic: Ratio, Proportion, Profit and Commission

outcomes.text: Define ratio and proportion, continued proportion and mean proportional.
Explain how ratios, fractions and percentages relate.
Use ratio and proportion to split quantities, such as partner profit shares.
Solve direct and inverse proportion problems, including time-work and time-distance.
Calculate compound and mixed ratios for profit sharing among three or more partners.
Define cost price, selling price, marked price, invoice price, mark-up and margin.
Define profit and loss in terms of cost and selling price.
Calculate profit, loss and their percentages.
Calculate mark-up and margin percentages and convert between them.
Compare trade and cash discount and their effect on invoice and net price.
Calculate net price after single and chained trade discounts.
Calculate cash discount and amount payable under credit terms.
Explain commission and brokerage in trade and sales.
Calculate commission, brokerage and agent earnings, including slab-based commission.
Analyse cases mixing ratio, discount, mark-up and commission to decide on pricing or profit sharing.
Evaluate pricing, discount or commission options and recommend the best.

units.title: Domain C: Equations and Marginal Analysis

outcomes.text: Explain why simultaneous and quadratic equations matter for break-even and equilibrium.
Solve two-variable linear equations such as market equilibrium price.
Solve quadratic equations for break-even, maximum profit or minimum cost.
Calculate marginal cost, revenue and profit by the difference-quotient method.
Use a difference table to find the output that maximises profit or minimises cost.

topics.title: Interest and time value of money

outcomes.text: Define simple and compound interest and state their formulas.
Calculate simple and compound interest.
Explain nominal versus effective annual interest rates.
Calculate the effective annual rate from a nominal rate.
Explain discounting and compounding for present and future values.
Calculate present and future value of a single amount.
Calculate present and future value of an annuity such as instalments.
Compare simple, compound and annuity financing and choose the best option.

units.title: Domain E: Statistical Measures and Data Analysis

outcomes.text: Define data, frequency, mean, median and mode.
Classify data as qualitative, quantitative, primary or secondary.
Explain survey, questionnaire, census and sampling methods.
Differentiate population from sample and explain why we sample.
Pick a suitable sampling method, such as random or convenience, for a case.
Summarise and present data with tables, frequency distributions and graphs.
Calculate mean, median and mode for ungrouped and grouped data.
Identify when to use range, variance and standard deviation.
Compute variance, standard deviation and coefficient of variation.
Analyse variability to compare consistency of two data sets such as security returns.
Define index numbers and their types: price, quantity, value.
Explain uses of index numbers such as consumer price index and producer price index.
Calculate simple and weighted index numbers.
Evaluate whether a base year suits long-term price comparison.
Construct a deflated or inflated series from index numbers.

units.title: Domain G: Correlation Coefficient and Linear Regression

outcomes.text: Explain correlation and regression, their uses and limits.
Calculate correlation and rank correlation coefficients.
Calculate a least-squares regression line, such as sales on advertising.
Calculate the coefficient of determination and interpret relationship strength.

units.title: Domain H: Probability and Probability Distributions for Business Decisions

outcomes.text: Define permutation and combination and state their formulas.
Count outcomes and arrangements using permutations and combinations.
Explain total and favourable outcomes and the basic rules of probability.
Explain mutually exclusive versus independent events.
Calculate the probability of a simple event classically.
Use the addition rule for mutually exclusive events.
Use the multiplication rule for independent events.
